supersedes: 4V4_ENTITY_REPAIR_ASYMMETRIC_RECOVERY_READING.json, which rested on a contaminated pi_B3 (PI_B3_TRAIN_EVAL_POLE_MISMATCH_INVALIDATION.json) and is retracted in its delta_B half.
VERDICT: With a properly trained pi_B3 (attested against the certified Pole B), the 4v4 entity-repair joint gate FAILS. delta_A passes cleanly. delta_B is now a CONFIRMED, decisive reversal -- not the inconclusive null the contaminated run produced.

PRIMARY_GATE_OUTCOME.delta_B_character: DECISIVE reversal -- entire bootstrap interval negative (ucb95=-0.0469). Contrast with the invalid run's delta_B=-0.086 [-0.195,+0.023], whose interval straddled zero. Removing the training/eval confound did not soften the negative signal -- it sharpened it.

THE_STRIKING_PATTERN: pi_A3 beats Pole B (0.7422) more often than pi_B3_corrected does (0.5859) -- despite pi_B3_corrected being the specialist SPECIFICALLY TRAINED against Pole B, now correctly. pi_A3 also beats Pole A (0.8125) far more than pi_B3_corrected does (0.5391). pi_A3 dominates BOTH poles; pi_B3_corrected is mediocre on both, including its own. This is not two complementary specialists -- it is one strong generalist (pi_A3) and one weak policy (pi_B3_corrected).
PRECEDENT_THIS_MATCHES: identical qualitative pattern to EXPLORATORY_4V4_SPECIALIST_CROSSOVER (pre-repair, 2026-09-07): delta_B=-0.3047, entirely negative interval, one policy strong against both poles. The entity-repair intervention changed the MAGNITUDE (delta_B moved from -0.30 to -0.16, and delta_A moved from a failing +0.25 to a passing +0.27... comparable to the sealed pre-repair B3-3 baseline's delta_A=+0.047[-0.070,+0.156], FAILED) but did NOT change the QUALITATIVE pattern: pi_A-side dominance persists.

COMPARISON_TABLE_across_the_investigatio.reading: delta_A passes in BOTH the contaminated and corrected entity-repair runs (0.352 and 0.273 respectively -- same sign, comparable magnitude, both clear the 0.20 reproduction threshold used elsewhere in this investigation). This is independent partial evidence that the delta_A finding is not an artifact of the B-side contamination. delta_B, however, moved from inconclusive to decisively negative once measured correctly -- the contamination was NOT hiding a positive B result; if anything it was masking a worse one.

WHAT_THIS_MEANS_FOR_THE_INVESTIGATION_SO.H1_geometry_load_bearing_at_inference_fo: that experiment used the CONTAMINATED pi_B3 as the off-pole comparator for C_A, L_B, and delta_A_zero. C_A and L_B are contaminated and must not be trusted. L_A (pi_A3 FULL vs ZERO, no comparator) remains clean and still shows no measurable inference-time dependence on geometry for pi_A3 alone.
WHAT_THIS_MEANS_FOR_THE_INVESTIGATION_SO.POLE_B_ENTITY_UTILIZATION: the pi_B3@PoleB cell measured the WRONG policy on an opponent it never trained on. Not informative about whether a correctly-trained pi_B3 uses geometry on Pole B. The pi_A3@PoleA cell is unaffected.
WHAT_THIS_MEANS_FOR_THE_INVESTIGATION_SO.what_is_now_new_and_clean: this is the FIRST valid measurement of how a properly-trained entity-repair Pole-B specialist actually performs. It says the representation repair, as implemented, does not produce a Pole-B specialist competitive with the Pole-A specialist even on its own home pole.

PRECOMMITTED_BRANCH_THIS_LANDS_IN: 4V4_ENTITY_REPAIR_SPEC.json#PRECOMMITTED_DECISION_TREE -> delta_A passes, delta_B fails -- 'only ONE regime specializes ... partial/asymmetric recovery' remains the nominal branch label, but the CHARACTER differs from what that branch anticipated: this is not a near-miss or an inconclusive null on Pole B, it is a confirmed, sizeable reversal in which the Pole-A specialist outperforms the Pole-B specialist on Pole B itself.
